Summary Of All Podcasts On This Page

Join Jack Smith, a 25-year-plus IT veteran, as he takes you on a hilariously chilling journey through the wild world of tech mishaps. Each episode will leave you laughing and maybe crying a little as we navigate the absurdity of everyday tech disasters. In this podcast series we delve into the bizarre and often cringe-worthy world of IT mishaps, glitches, and the horror stories that come with it. With a sarcastic twist we recount the tales of those who somehow manage to create chaos out of the simplest tasks. Striking a balance between relatable frustration and dark humor that gets even the most cringe-inducing stories entertaining and you will find yourself laughing, cringing, and shaking their heads in disbelief as we take a wild ride through the chaotic world of IT, where every glitch is a ghost story waiting to be told.

Ship It Weekly DevOps, SRE, and Platform Engineering News is your go-to weekly briefing for everything that matters in modern infrastructure, reliability engineering, and platform operations. Hosted by Brian Teller of Teller's Tech, this show distills the week's most important developments in cloud engineering, DevOps tooling, outages, incident postmortems, system releases, and platform ecosystem shifts into concise, practical episodes that help you stay sharp without wading through a sea of status pages and blog posts. Whether you're a seasoned SRE, platform engineer, cloud native practitioner, or on-call responder, Ship It Weekly keeps you informed about real world updates that impact your systems and teams.

Each episode zeroes in on the technologies, outages, and trends shaping how services are built and operated at scale. You'll hear thoughtful analysis of major cloud provider incidents, Kubernetes and infrastructure trends, changes in Terraform and IaC workflows, new tools worth bookmarking, and meaningful takeaways from real postmortems all framed not merely as headlines, but as insights you can act on in your own environment. Alongside the technical news, the show occasionally touches on on-call culture, burnout, team collaboration, reliability best practices, and the human side of running distributed systems.

The format is short and focused most episodes range from 10 to 25 minutes making Ship It Weekly ideal for your commute, a coffee break, or between meetings. You'll walk away with clear context on what happened this week in DevOps and SRE, why it matters to your architecture and operations, and what you might do differently or watch closely next. Whether you're responsible for uptime, performance, or scaling challenges, this show helps you cut through the noise and get straight to the signals.

This podcast will give you help you with passing your CompTIA exams. We also sprinkle different technology topics.

FusionTalk is an engaging and insightful podcast where technology, collaboration, and innovation converge. Hosted by Anouck Fierens, a seasoned expert in Microsoft 365 and the Power Platform, alongside Steve Dalby, a SharePoint and Teams specialist known for his wit and humor, FusionTalk offers a fresh, accessible take on the evolving digital workplace. Each episode features thought-provoking conversations with industry leaders, real-world case studies, and actionable tips that help listeners navigate the modern tech landscape. Whether you're an IT professional, digital strategist, or simply curious about how to make your workday more productive, FusionTalk delivers value through relatable stories and practical advice. What to Expect: Smart strategies for modern workplace collaboration Expert commentary on Microsoft technologies Real-life examples that highlight successes (and lessons learned) FusionTalk is your go-to resource for staying ahead in today's fast-paced, tech-driven world. It's more than just a podcast - it's a community of professionals sharing ideas, experiences, and a few laughs along the way. Tune in and discover how you can work smarter, faster, and more efficiently with the tools and knowledge that matter most. #FusionTalk #TechPodcast #DigitalWorkplace #SmartCollaboration

He was co-founder of Color Health, Mixer Labs (which was acquired by Twitter). He has invested in over 40 companies now worth $1B or more each, and is also author of the High Growth Handbook.

A family of abandoned AI robots are left to fend for themselves in a world full of humans. What could possibly go wrong? Enter an absurd world where AI constantly trips over its own human biases and falls flat on its algorithmic face. Made in AI follows a family of AI robots abandoned by their creators, navigating survival with their own resources. Now in its fifth season, this comedy has been voted one of the Top Five podcasts by Goodpods and ranks in the Top Ten by ReHack. Created by humans with AI assistance at every production stagefrom advising on AI behavior to performing the scriptthis podcast promises to make you laugh, ponder mind-bending concepts, and experience a new dimension in storytelling. ## Summary Of All Podcasts On This Page

Join Jack Smith, a 25-year-plus IT veteran, as he takes you on a hilariously chilling journey through the wild world of tech mishaps. Each episode will leave you laughing and maybe crying a little as we navigate the absurdity of everyday tech disasters. In this podcast series we delve into the bizarre and often cringe-worthy world of IT mishaps, glitches, and the horror stories that come with it. With a sarcastic twist we recount the tales of those who somehow manage to create chaos out of the simplest tasks. Striking a balance between relatable frustration and dark humor that gets even the most cringe-inducing stories entertaining and you will find yourself laughing, cringing, and shaking their heads in disbelief as we take a wild ride through the chaotic world of IT, where every glitch is a ghost story waiting to be told.

Ship It Weekly DevOps, SRE, and Platform Engineering News is your go-to weekly briefing for everything that matters in modern infrastructure, reliability engineering, and platform operations. Hosted by Brian Teller of Teller's Tech, this show distills the week's most important developments in cloud engineering, DevOps tooling, outages, incident postmortems, system releases, and platform ecosystem shifts into concise, practical episodes that help you stay sharp without wading through a sea of status pages and blog posts. Whether you're a seasoned SRE, platform engineer, cloud native practitioner, or on-call responder, Ship It Weekly keeps you informed about real world updates that impact your systems and teams.

Each episode zeroes in on the technologies, outages, and trends shaping how services are built and operated at scale. You'll hear thoughtful analysis of major cloud provider incidents, Kubernetes and infrastructure trends, changes in Terraform and IaC workflows, new tools worth bookmarking, and meaningful takeaways from real postmortems all framed not merely as headlines, but as insights you can act on in your own environment. Alongside the technical news, the show occasionally touches on on-call culture, burnout, team collaboration, reliability best practices, and the human side of running distributed systems.

The format is short and focused most episodes range from 10 to 25 minutes making Ship It Weekly ideal for your commute, a coffee break, or between meetings. You'll walk away with clear context on what happened this week in DevOps and SRE, why it matters to your architecture and operations, and what you might do differently or watch closely next. Whether you're responsible for uptime, performance, or scaling challenges, this show helps you cut through the noise and get straight to the signals.
